sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You are likely to stick to basics instead of letting your imagination run wild today, says Ganesha. At work, you may feel some pressure from your peers to do things differently. Think things out and be certain before you take any decision, advises Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: Your plans meet with harsh opposition today, Taurus. You've been going along at a slow and steady pace, but you will find that abrasive tension arises the more you try to force your will on others. Gridlock is quite likely due to the fact that there are strong forces coming to a head. Neither one of them is in the mood to yield now.

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Take a spiritual approach toward cultivating better habits, dearest Taurus. Your imagination comes to life while the Capricorn quarter Moon rises, but you'll need to get organized to see grand visions through. View your situation from a holistic lens, observing how wellness practices, daily routines, and planning play into your ability to produce. Meditate on what your next stage of healing looks like when Chiron stirs later this afternoon. You'll feel serious about taking control of your future once Luna debuts in Aquarius this evening. A bit of journaling before bed can help you fill in logistical gaps when Neptune activates.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Any of your movable property can get stolen today. Hence, you need to take good care of them. New friendships will develop at a function you attend today. This is the peak of their career where they must study and move forward in life. Your spouse is really in a good mood today. You might get a surprise. You will forget all your worries today and let your creative side take over you.

readings.text: You might be lost in deep thoughts most of the day. You may be imaginative or turn emotional. You may not remain practical at the workplace. You seem to be confused and will lack concentration. Taking responsibilities will be difficult. As a result, your progress is likely to suffer.

Your luck is going to improve during the next three weeks. A new phase in your yearly cycle starts today that signals the beginning of an upswing for you. Relations with others you work with will be much more favorable overall.

bits.t: At work, you may feel some pressure from your peers to do things differently.
This is the peak of their career where they must study and move forward in life.

readings.text: The day by and large looks darker than other days, as far as money matters are concerned. However, remember that there is always a ‘good morning’ after darkest night.

This week is about your home, which may mean having to spend more to get good quality goods or an emergency plumber to fix a broken sink. Whatever the case, know that it's going to be better soon. Meanwhile, a supportive aspect transforms your dreams. Don't give up on that wild scheme yet. It may yield results soon.

Health wise, it’s not going to be a good day, says Ganesha. So, you will be able to complete tasks on hand but you may also end up wasting your time behind things that are not on your priority list. Don’t waste energy in useless things.

The celestial atmosphere of the day makes you feel like there is a conspiracy out there plotting to overthrow you! This is unlikely, though your feelings are certainly valid. Try to express yourself to those around you and ask for the emotional reassurance you need. You do not need to expose yourself too much, just acknowledge to yourself and others that you're feeling a bit vulnerable right now. This is a time to pay special attention to your exercise regimen.

bits.t: Neither one of them is in the mood to yield now.
Take a spiritual approach toward cultivating better habits, dearest Taurus.
View your situation from a holistic lens, observing how wellness practices, daily routines, and planning play into your ability to produce.
Your spouse is really in a good mood today.

lucky.remedy: Place a golden idol of your deity in the pooja ghar or family altar, and worship daily for great health.

extras.title: Bonus
extras.text: You may have to step out of your comfort zone to prove you're no doormat.
